title: feat(spec)!: retire the ADR-0078 conversion-conflict channel — onConflict / reservedNodeTypes, the notice types, the conflicts arrays and the FLOW_CONVERSION_CONFLICT 409
body:
Fixes #24001
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

## What this does

Retires ADR-0078's conversion-**conflict** channel, which has had no producer since #23543 F5-http (PR #23954) reserved the three old callout node types (`FLOW_RESERVED_NODE_TYPES`). Per the card's "Reader who acts" and triage `6221525633`:

- **`@objectstack/spec`**: the root exports `CONVERSION_CONFLICT_CODE`, `ConversionConflictNotice`, `ConversionConflictDetail` leave; `ApplyConversionsOptions` loses `onConflict` / `reservedNodeTypes` (and so `StoredConversionOptions`), `ConversionContext` loses `reservedNodeTypes` / `reportConflict`, `IAutomationService.canonicalizeStoredFlow`'s result loses `conflicts`. `api-surface/root.json` and `export-origins/root.json` regenerated (−3 each); `declaration-map/` did not move (`check:generated`: all 14 current).
- **Error code**: `FLOW_CONVERSION_CONFLICT` comes out of `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` by the ledger's own "Retiring a code" rule ("A row whose last EMITTER is deleted comes out with it"; precedent `OVERLAY_PERSISTENCE_FAILED`). `retired-error-codes.ts` is NOT used: that table is for `StandardErrorCode` catalogue members only (#17707's `CONCURRENT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`), and this is a ledger row. The error catalog's 409 row is the generated `content/docs/references/api/{contract,error-code-ledger}.mdx` entry (regenerated by `gen:docs`); `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx` never listed it.
- **Dispatcher vocabulary**: the `OS_METADATA_CONVERSION_CONFLICT` `foreign-vocabulary` row (its stamp site in `apply.ts` is gone) is deleted; the running-log comments no longer spell the retired code.
- **`@objectstack/service-automation`**: `canonicalizeFlow` / `canonicalizeStoredFlow` no longer build the live-name set or collect `conflicts`; `plugin.ts`'s inert-mode rationale is restated for what still needs the registry (the registration preview's descriptor checks).
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`**: `StoredFlowCanonicalization` loses `conflicts`; four consumer branches go — the save door's 409, the stored-migration pass's `failed` row, `duplicatePackage`'s failed item and `importUnmanagedPackage`'s 409 — with their docblocks.
- **D3 semantic entry** `conversion-conflict-channel-removed` (no D2 conversion, no tombstone: no metadata document ever carried any of it). One BREAKING `minor` changeset with FROM → TO, marker `adr-0087: registered conversion-conflict-channel-removed`.

`FLOW_RESERVED_NODE_TYPES` and the F5-http reservation are untouched.

## Hypothesis 1 — zero producers (measured on `origin/main` `fd9664ffac`, before any edit)

`git grep -n -E 'reportConflict\(|onConflict|reservedNodeTypes|ConversionConflictNotice|ConversionConflictDetail|FLOW_CONVERSION_CONFLICT|ConversionConflict'` (excluding `CHANGELOG.md`), plus `CONVERSION_CONFLICT_CODE|OS_METADATA_CONVERSION_CONFLICT` and `reportConflict|\.conflicts\b`:

| site | role |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/spec/src/conversions/types.ts:37` `CONVERSION_CONFLICT_CODE`, `:96` `ConversionConflictDetail`, `:110` `ConversionConflictNotice`, `:178`-`:180` context members | declaration |
| `packages/spec/src/conversions/apply.ts:70` / `:96` options, `:139`, `:158`-`:168` the `reportConflict` bridge | bridge (sink wiring), not a producer |
| `packages/spec/src/conversions/index.ts:13,17,18` | re-export |
| `packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts:20,857` | declaration (contract field) |
| `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts:84` | comment (the guard's own retirement note) |
| `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts:70,4528,4575,4609-4628` | consumer (builds the set, collects into an array) |
| `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:23077` (save door 409), `:24168` (stored pass), `:27555` (`duplicatePackage`), `:27829`/`:27853` (unmanaged import 409); `stored-migration.ts:60` | consumer |
| `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-error-vocabulary.ts:292,598,672` | gate ledger |
| conversions / stored / metadata-protocol / service-automation tests | test doubles that CONSTRUCT a conflict (not producers) |
| `onConflict` hits in `automation/execution.zod.ts`, `data/data-engine.zod.ts`, `driver-sql`, `types/unbacked-conflict-target.ts`, `check-tenant-chokepoint.mjs` | unrelated members of the same name |

**Producer of a conflict = a conversion entry calling `context.reportConflict`: zero.** No `MetadataConversion.apply` reads `context` for it; `flow-node-http-callout-rename`'s `apply(stack, emit)` takes no context at all. No fork, so the hard delete proceeded.

Cross-repo: `objectui` at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `f8267df9` and at its HEAD `360e27a` — **0** hits for all seven spellings, control `defineStack` lit (38 / 37 files). `cloud` is private and was **NOT MEASURED** (the ledger rule asks for it; see the report's open question).

## Pins (one per retired export / code), all in `packages/spec/src/conversions/conversion-conflict-channel-retirement.test.ts`

- `§1 … every retired name has ZERO holders on any public entry, and the survivors still stand on the root` — `CONVERSION_CONFLICT_CODE`, `ConversionConflictNotice`, `ConversionConflictDetail` by resolved symbol identity (`export-origins/`), survivors `CONVERSION_TODO_CODE`, `ConversionTodoNotice`, `ConversionContext`, … present.
- `§1 … the runtime barrel resolves without the retired constant and keeps its TODO twin`.
- `§1 … the D3 semantic entry is registered on step 18`.
- `§2 … the retired members are absent at the type level, the surviving ones present` — `onConflict`, `reservedNodeTypes` (options and context), `reportConflict`, the result's `conflicts`; compiled by `check:test-typecheck`.
- `§3 … ErrorCode no longer parses it, and no owner lists it` — `FLOW_CONVERSION_CONFLICT`, with `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT` / `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` as lit controls.
- `tree-scoped absence … no retired spelling survives inside the declared radius outside the retirement kit` — all seven spellings over `packages` / `examples` / `skills` / `content` / `scripts` (the #15513 radius, this file added as a witness on each `heldBy` row in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`, and in `vitest.repo-tests.json`). Excluded: the pin itself, `packages/spec/src/migrations/` (the D3 entry), the git-ignored generated `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/` (the D3 registry's projection), `content/docs/releases/`, `.changeset/`, `CHANGELOG.md`.

## Ablation (one, on the pin file)

Restored the deleted export in `packages/spec/src/conversions/index.ts` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `630ed35f` → `2bec0047`), ran the pin file: **2 failed / 4 passed** — `the runtime barrel resolves without the retired constant…` and the tree-scoped absence (offenders `index.ts spells CONVERSION_CONFLICT_CODE` / `OS_METADATA_CONVERSION_CONFLICT`). The `export-origins` holder pin stayed green, as it must: it reads the committed artifact, which the source mutation does not regenerate (`check:export-origins` is that half's gate). Restored: blob == HEAD `630ed35f`, `git diff HEAD` empty; re-run **6 / 6 passed**. A first attempt was a no-op — its replacement contained its own anchor, so the tool refused (count 1 → 1) and ran nothing; it is not counted.

The ablation also surfaced a real gap, fixed before push: the git-ignored upgrade-guide page `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/18.md`, once generated locally, prints the D3 entry verbatim, so the scan now excludes that projection like the registry it projects.

## Serial constraint (hypothesis 5)

PR #23986 (#23903) also edits `protocol.ts`: its hunks sit at the `flowSaveReplaysRetired` docblock/body (~6612–6700) and the save door's comment and fallback lines (~23025–23115). This PR's save-door hunk is the `result.conflicts` branch below them (~23077–23094 at the base) plus three other doors. **Disjoint**: each lands on its own, and whichever lands second merges `main`. #23986's new test builds its canonicalizer stub with `conflicts: []` as a standalone arrow (no contextual type, so no excess-property check): it should still compile after this lands, as a dead key — whichever lands second re-runs that suite on the merge. #24010's three lines are in the package door, not touched here.

## Acceptance notes

- File surface beyond the claim, comment/doc only: `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts`, `packages/cli/src/utils/data-migration-plugins.ts` (comments that justified the inert engine by the conflict guard) and `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` (the "flow whose rename the conflict guard refused" decline row and two sentences) — each described a failure mode this PR removes. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/stored-migration.ts` is the `StoredFlowCanonicalization` declaration the claim's "the contract's `conflicts` arrays" names. `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and `packages/spec/vitest.repo-tests.json` declare the new pin's radius.
- Four tests that pinned the removed branches are deleted with them (`a refused rename fails the item…`, `a refused rename fails the save loudly…`, `the conflict path stays silent — the 409 IS the signal`, `fails the row loudly when the guard refuses a rename over a live name`): each constructed a conflict through a test double and asserted the branch this PR deletes.
- The stored pass's `skipped` reason for a flow with no engine is reworded (it named the conflict guard); no test pins its prose.
- ADR-0078's status note and the ADR-0087 addendum note are in a separate governed PR (`claude/issue-24001-adr-0078-note`).

## Verification

Reported in full in the `os-dev-report` comment on #24001 (local gate union with exit codes, reconciled `--ran` 139/139; per-package `pnpm test`).
